'''Clausura:''' [[Heredia Jaguares de Peten|Heredia]] 6–1 [[Deportivo Zacapa|Zacapa]] |matches = 120 |total goals = 323 |prevseason = [[2010–11 Liga Nacional de Guatemala|2010–11]] |nextseason = [[2012–13 Liga Nacional de Guatemala|2012–13]] }} The '''2011–12 Liga Nacional de Guatemala''' was the 59th professional season of the top-flight football league in [[Guatemala]]. The season was divided into two championships—the [[#Apertura|2011 Apertura]] and the [[#Clausura|2012 Clausura]]—each in an identical format and each contested by the same 12 teams. ==Format== The format for both championships are identical. Each championship will have two stages: a first stage and a playoff stage. The first stage of each championship is a double round-robin format. The teams that finishes 1 and 2 in the standings will advance to the playoffs semifinals, while the teams that finish 3–6 will enter in the quarterfinals. The winner of each quarterfinals will advance to the semifinals. The winners of the semifinals will advance to the finals, which will determine the tournament champion. ==Teams== [[Universidad de San Carlos (Guatemalan football club)|USAC]] and [[Deportivo Xinabajul|Xinabajul]] finished in 11th and 12th place, respectively, in the overall table of [[2009–10 Liga Nacional de Guatemala season|last season]] and were relegated to the [[Primera División de Ascenso|Primera División]].
